remediation_tasks.action: Select maintained rebuilt base digests/OS package fixes; retain selected runtime versions where possible. Rescan and rerun affected runtime/schema/service fixtures before adopting candidates.

remediation_tasks.target: Temporal server/admin-tools, SeaweedFS and gosu embedded Go dependencies
remediation_tasks.action: Obtain upstream rebuilt binaries or reviewed builds with patched Go/modules. Installed host Go does not patch binaries embedded in images. Verify actual compiled versions and rescan; do not hot-edit running services.

remediation_tasks.target: pip-vendored msgpack/urllib3/pkg_resources metadata in Python base/worker images
remediation_tasks.action: Upgrade the complete pip bundle or remove build/package-manager tooling in a verified final runtime stage. A top-level urllib3 upgrade alone does not replace pip._vendor. Retest parser/workflow/storage integration and preserve unsuppressed baseline reports.
Refresh supported patch digest and rescan. Separately document CVE-2026-31789 architecture/vendor severity applicability; do not equate raw critical package counts to confirmed critical exploits.

Review actual frontend/API/worker dependency locks and exact adopted images before product execution. Reserved/uninstalled frontend candidates are not audited application installations; no exploit reachability or full host/Docker/WSL security certification was performed.

applicability_notes.disposition: Architecture-related non-applicability candidate; not suppressed or automatically accepted
Versions and actual vendor module paths corroborated. Top-level distribution absence is not proof of absence or non-reachability. Package advisories and reachability require distinct review.
